chapters.title: Alive to Write a Little More
chapters.synopsis: Moroni, who had not expected to survive, writes a few more things that may one day be of worth to the Lamanites. The wars among the Lamanites are exceedingly fierce, and they kill every Nephite who will not deny the Christ. Moroni will not deny him, so he wanders wherever he can for the safety of his life.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: Moroni writes for the Lamanites' future good

chapters.title: Power to Give the Holy Ghost
chapters.synopsis: Moroni records the words Christ spoke when he touched his twelve disciples one by one. They were to call on the Father in mighty prayer and then have power to give the Holy Ghost by the laying on of hands. This the disciples did to all who came unto them.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: Christ's words on conferring the Holy Ghost

chapters.title: Ordaining Priests and Teachers
chapters.synopsis: Moroni preserves the manner in which the disciples ordained priests and teachers. After praying to the Father in the name of Christ, they laid on hands and ordained by the power of the Holy Ghost. The words of the ordination are given so the pattern will not be lost.

chapters.title: The Prayer on the Bread
chapters.synopsis: Moroni gives the exact manner of administering the sacramental bread according to Christ's commandment. The elder or priest kneels with the church and blesses the bread. The prayer asks that all who partake may eat in remembrance of the Son's body and always keep his Spirit.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: The manner of blessing the bread

chapters.title: The Prayer on the Wine
chapters.synopsis: Moroni records the short companion prayer for the sacramental wine. Those who drink do it in remembrance of the blood of the Son, which was shed for them. In return they witness to the Father that they always remember him, that they may have his Spirit.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: The manner of blessing the wine

chapters.title: Nourished by the Good Word
chapters.synopsis: Moroni describes how baptism required a broken heart and fruits of real repentance. Members were numbered and remembered, nourished by the good word of God, and met often to fast, pray, and partake of the sacrament. Meetings were conducted as the Spirit directed, and sincere repentance always brought forgiveness.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: How the church received and nourished members

chapters.title: Faith, Hope, and Charity
chapters.synopsis: Moroni records his father Mormon's synagogue sermon on the peaceable followers of Christ. Mormon teaches how to judge between good and evil by the light of Christ, that angels have not ceased to minister, and that miracles end only when faith dies. He crowns the sermon with charity, the pure love of Christ, without which we are nothing.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Mormon's sermon on faith, hope, charity

chapters.title: Little Children Are Alive in Christ
chapters.synopsis: In an epistle to Moroni, Mormon condemns the baptism of little children as solemn mockery before God. Little children are whole, alive in Christ through his atonement, and need no repentance; it is parents and the accountable who must repent and be baptized. To suppose otherwise denies the mercies of Christ.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: An epistle from Mormon to Moroni

chapters.title: Labor While the Vessel Holds
chapters.synopsis: Mormon's second epistle describes a people past feeling, delighting in abomination and atrocity on both sides of the war. Though his heart breaks, he urges Moroni to labor diligently, for they have a labor to perform while in this tabernacle of clay. May Christ lift thee up, he writes, and the hope of his glory rest in your mind forever.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Labor on; may Christ lift thee up

chapters.title: Moroni's Farewell Promise
chapters.synopsis: Moroni's final words exhort readers to ask God, with real intent, whether these things are true, promising an answer by the power of the Holy Ghost. He reviews the gifts of God and pleads, come unto Christ and be perfected in him. He closes looking to the day he will meet the reader before the pleasing bar of the great Jehovah.

segments.speaker: moroni
segments.note: Written to the Lamanites, and all readers
